description: Calibration questions for the grounding gate (Day 3) and seed of the Day 7 golden set, over the 10-document corpus. In-corpus questions carry a verbatim evidence phrase; 'expected' lists every page of the whole corpus where that phrase appears (table-of-contents pages excluded), because the same passage often repeats across the framework and the pillars. 'intendedFile' is the document the question was written from. Tag 'paraphrase' marks questions with little keyword overlap with their page. Types: IN_CORPUS; OUT_FAR (unrelated topic); OUT_NEAR (same domain, not AWS-specific content); OUT_AWS (an AWS question whose specific answer is not in these PDFs). Out-of-corpus questions list terms verified absent from the corpus. Split: every 4th question of each type is held out and not used to choose the threshold.

questions.question: What are the six pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
questions.evidence: operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability

questions.question: Why does the framework advise to stop guessing capacity needs?
questions.evidence: Stop guessing your capacity needs

questions.question: What is the difference between one-way door and two-way door decisions?

questions.question: What does recovery time objective (RTO) mean?

questions.question: How should a client retry failed requests without overloading a service?
